title: Learning to pray; recap of his advice; the golf-lesson point on teachers
summary: Thomas says Christian Science taught him to pray; Hinton sums up math, religion and talent; Thomas says a good teacher matters.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Life philosophy: faith, karma and how to live

blocks.x: Yeah. And another thing that I found out... And this is tracking back into Christian Science. I found out if you learn how to pray, God will answer your prayers.
How do you learn how to pray, Foots? How do you learn that?
Thomas (Pt.2) - 23

Well, I learned it through studying Christian Science. They bring out out the point in Christian Science that you studied scholarly(?). You remember the masters, they'd go in the closet and shut the door? They'd say shut out all the material senses and pray to God in silence.
[PAUSE]
So for a conclusion, Foots, your advice to young people is, one, get a little mathematics, is that what you were saying?
Yeah.
And being a man of a religious background, you've found great solace in Christian Science. Is that right?
Mmm-hmm.
Even your teacher, Timothy, was a Scientist.
A Scientist. I told you, he brought out things, and I understood him so clearly, how he fought.
Then you talked about trying to find your own talents.
Yeah, find...
Now, is that very difficult?
I don't think so. It wasn't hard for me. Of course, it was kind of late in life when I found it out, but I was involved... I found out I had the tendency to be a
Thomas (Pt.2) - 24
good musician, and I just kept studying. And see, I didn't go to college, so all I could do was just keep studying.
Your decision. Personally study, then.

Yes. Now, I'd like to put this little one(?) on. I took a lesson from a guy in golf. Now, here's a guy who's a golfer, and he told me something so important. He said, "You can go to a teacher and learn how to do something now," he said, "and you may go through lifetime and never get the point."
Never do what?
You may go through a lifetime and never get the point of something the teacher can tell you what to do.
Of course.
Teachers are very important, as long as you get a good teacher.
